newsitem.title: FINLAND: US payrolls help quiet Helsinki close higher.
newsitem.headline: US payrolls help quiet Helsinki close higher.

text.p: Shares pared initial losses late on Friday after news U.S. August payrolls rose slightly in line with expectations, easing fears of an imminent hike in U.S. interest rates, brokers said.
The HEX index nudged up 0.46 percent to 2,719.49 with total volume a slim 233 million markka, but it fell 2.4 percent on the week.
Brokers saw scope for further gains on Monday after Wall Street rallied at its open on Friday. "There is still some upward bias left for on Monday," one broker noted.
Nokia closed featureless trade down 0.40 markka at 185.50, despite a firmer open on Wall Street. Volume was modest for Nokia at a little over 62 million markka or about one quarter of the total.

Forestry major UPM-Kymmene rose 0.40 markka to 100.00, mostly recovering from a fall on Thursday after it said it started a U.S. OTC programme for ADRs, which disappointed some investors who had hoped for a full New York listing.
"I am still hoping for a proper NYSE listing and I bet I'm not the only one," one broker said.
Sporting goods group Amer closed down 0.50 markka at 104.00, after it said it was further downsizing its Wilson operations.
Energy group and oil importer Neste extended losses following a jump in crude oil prices early this week.
